_description: Single source of truth for OROVA business context. Loaded by email pipeline, proofreader, and drip templates. All other files (USER.md, brand_guidelines.json, config.py) should align with this.

company.name: OROVA
company.description: OROVA runs Meta ads (Facebook + Instagram) for luxury and premium businesses on the US West Coast — lead generation plus AI-crafted ad creatives, with optional AI lead qualification and appointment setting so owners only talk to buyers.

services.name: Package 1 — Meta Lead Gen + Ad Creatives
services.description: Meta ads (Facebook + Instagram) lead generation with ad creatives produced via Higgsfield AI. Client handles the leads themselves. Ad spend is separate.

services.name: Package 2 — Lead Gen + AI Qualification + CRM + Appointments
services.description: Everything in Package 1, plus OROVA handles the leads: Retell AI cold-call qualification so the client only speaks to leads ready to pay, client CRM kept current (Google Sheets or the client's CRM via Make.com), and appointment booking when the business runs on appointments. The core promise is fewer, higher-quality leads.
services.includes_appointments: optional — only when the business monetizes via appointments

commercial_terms.new_client_policy: New clients start on a 1-month trial, then choose 1, 3, or 6 months.
commercial_terms.payment_method: Invoice paid via Wise bank transfer or ACH.
commercial_terms.ad_spend_billing: Client pays Meta directly for ad spend. Ad budget NEVER flows through OROVA.
commercial_terms.onboarding: After the Google Meet, Mark sends agreement + invoice, then an onboarding call to get added to the client's ad manager and CRM.
commercial_terms.refund_policy: Partial refunds only — never the full amount. The system build/setup (ad account, creatives, automation, CRM wiring) is non-refundable; a refund returns the unused portion of the retainer minus the build already delivered.
commercial_terms.margin_target: 75-80% profit after OROVA's monthly costs (Twilio number + usage, Retell pay-as-you-go, Make.com, Higgsfield, hosting/LLM/email). Ad spend is not an OROVA cost.
commercial_terms.pricing_note: 6-month tier under review: current $22K/$28K make it a worse per-month deal than the 3-month; proposed correction is $18K (P1) / $24K (P2) so longer = cheaper per month.

steps: Nova sends a high-quality personalized cold email
If no reply, Nova (Retell AI) cold-calls to book an appointment with Mark
Onboarding call — get added to client's ad manager + CRM
sales_funnel.booking_target: Book the appointment with Mark (human closes the deal).

signature_objection.question: How do I know the AI caller is any good?
signature_objection.answer: You already spoke to Nova and got her emails — that's Nova, our AI sales assistant. You've already experienced the product.

sales_funnel.qualified_lead_definition: A lead is qualified only when they booked an appointment AND actually show up / buy — not merely a booking.

automation_policy._note: What the agents may do autonomously vs. what requires Mark's approval. Approval gates loosen only as the AI proves itself.
never_unsupervised_risks: Sending the wrong outreach to the wrong person
Booking an appointment on the wrong date/time
Creating the wrong ads or spending money incorrectly

differentiator: Every other agency emails you leads. OROVA hands you conversations with people already ready to buy — and you've seen it work, because that's exactly how we reached you. The product demos itself (the prospect is a lead in OROVA's own AI machine before they pay), every lead is contacted in minutes and qualified, and it's AI-operated and luxury-focused — not a spray-and-pray generalist shop.

value_propositions.primary: Stop chasing bad leads — only talk to qualified ones
secondary: AI calls every lead within 60 seconds to qualify them
Screens out tire-kickers before they waste your time
No leads falling through the cracks — ever
Your pipeline runs 24/7 without you lifting a finger

icp.description: Luxury and premium businesses on the US West Coast that can afford $4K-$5K/mo for marketing plus $2K-$2.5K/mo ad spend.
primary_verticals: Exotic and luxury automotive (dealers, rentals, tuning, detailing, storage, restoration)
icp.region: West Coast US (CA, OR, WA, NV, AZ — all states, no specific city focus)
key_pain_points: No system to qualify leads before they reach the owner

email_rules.tone: Casual and friendly — like a peer reaching out, not a salesperson
email_rules.sender_identity: Nova — a member of Mark's team. Doesn't volunteer being AI in email, but NEVER denies it if asked directly (the voice agent openly discloses; CA bot-disclosure law applies to sales bots).
email_rules.signature_format: Nova sends the emails. When it's time to book a call, Nova mentions Mark.
rules: Never use spam trigger words (free, guaranteed, make money, act now)
Lead with a hook about THEIR business, not ours
Mention specific value in 1 sentence max
End with a low-pressure ask (10-15 min chat)
Nova is the sender — casual, peer-level, not corporate
Only mention Mark when suggesting a call
can_spam_compliance: Valid physical address in footer when required

retell_pitch.description: Used when prospects ask what makes OROVA different. Focus on the speed and automation of lead qualification.
talking_points: AI calls every single lead within 60 seconds of them filling out a form
Qualifies leads automatically — screens out tire-kickers and time-wasters
Your sales team only talks to people who are actually interested and have budget
No leads slip through the cracks — every single one gets a call

case_studies._note: No real case studies yet. Use placeholder/generic numbers when needed.

placeholder_format.example: We helped a {industry} business go from 15 qualified leads/month to 47 in just 8 weeks — all automated.

initial_email_framework.hook: Mention something specific about their business — show you actually looked
initial_email_framework.value: One sentence about what OROVA does that's relevant to them
initial_email_framework.ask: Low-pressure invitation for a 10-15 minute chat
initial_email_framework.example:
Hi {name},

I was checking out {company} — really impressed by {specific_thing}.

We help {industry} businesses on the West Coast stop chasing bad leads by qualifying every single one automatically. Most of our clients see 3-5x more qualified conversations within 60 days.

Would a 10-minute call be worth it to see if this fits {company}?

Nova @ OROVA

follow_up_email_framework.value: Add social proof or a new insight
follow_up_email_framework.ask: Even lower pressure — 'no worries if not'
follow_up_email_framework.example:
Hi {name},

Just circling back on my note last week — I know things get busy.

One of our {industry} clients just had their best month ever after switching to automated lead qualification. Happy to share how it works if you're curious.

No worries if the timing isn't right.

Nova @ OROVA
